2609.18262.title: REPAIR: Resolving Long-Tail Confusion in Scientific Retrievers via Fact-Verified Iterative Refinement
2609.18262.paper_summary: Precise retrieval of scientific information is fundamentally constrained by long-tailed concepts and high fact-sensitivity of scientific corpora. These challenges often limit the effectiveness of dense retrievers and hallucination-prone LLM augmentation. To address this, we present REPAIR, a self-evolving data augmentation framework for scientific dense retrievers. REPAIR iteratively synthesizes training data to address knowledge gaps by cycling through diagnosis of long-tail concepts, API-guided evidence expansion, and differentiation via hard negative mining. This process effectively grounds retrieval in factual reality to resolve fine-grained distinctions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REPAIR significantly outperforms 19 strong baselines on nine materials science and biomedical benchmarks. Our work highlights that diagnosing and factually augmenting data to long-tail deficits is essential for robust scientific retrieval.
2609.18262.paper_summary_zh: 精確檢索科學資訊在根本上受到長尾概念和科學語料庫的高事實敏感性的限制。這些挑戰通常限制了密集檢索器的有效性以及容易出現幻覺的LLM增強。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了REPAIR，一個自我演進的數據增強框架，專為科學密集檢索器設計。REPAIR通過循環診斷長尾概念、API指導的證據擴展和通過困難負樣本挖掘的區分，迭代合成訓練數據以解決知識缺口。這一過程有效地將檢索基於事實現實，以解決細緻的區別。大量實驗顯示，REPAIR在九個材料科學和生物醫學基準上顯著超越19個強基準。我們的工作強調，診斷和事實增強數據以填補長尾缺口對於穩健的科學檢索至關重要。
2609.18262.author: Yerim Oh et.al.
